title: SAALONOVA
description: SAALONOVA is a browser-based statistical analysis tool for balanced agricultural field experiments, supporting CRD, RBD, split-plot, strip-plot and split-split-plot designs, year-wise ANOVA, homogeneity testing, pooled analysis and mean separation procedures.

creators.name: Dey, Prithwiraj
creators.affiliation: Agricultural & Food Engineering Department, Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur
